pages.text: The $(major)XP Attraction Field/$ Gene causes players to $(minor)grab XP Orbs from a much larger distance/$.$(br2)This Gene is disabled when the player has an active $(l:genetics_resequenced:items/anti_field_orb)Anti-Field Orb/$, is near an active $(l:genetics_resequenced:blocks/anti_field_block)Anti-Field Block/$, or when sneaking.$(br2)This Gene $(bad)cannot be given to mobs/$.
